en: ...Ugh.
You've come to.
You're... Stayen?

jp: クレイス様に頼まれて
貴方をここまで運んだのよ
en: Kreis-sama asked me to carry you this far.

jp: このまま逃げさせてもらう
en: Of course, we intend to keep running from here.

jp: 気を失ってる女の子に
手荒なマネは出来ないさ
en: Can't rough up a girl who's out cold, after all.
Don't tell me, that sound...

jp: 本格的に始まったみたいね
en: Sounds like it's started for real.

jp: 十審将同士のぶつかり合い・・
en: A clash between Tribunal Generals...

jp: マティアお姉ちゃんとキロタ
en: Matia-neesan and Kilota... will they be okay?

jp: ヨハネさんも心配ですわ
en: I'm worried about Johannes-san, too.

jp: 助けて頂いたことには
en: For saving me, you have my thanks.

jp: しかし、無抵抗の敵を殺せない
貴方がたの甘さ、いつか
en: But your softness, sparing a helpless enemy, will be the death of you one day.

jp: 誰も傷つけずにいたい
en: ...But if I can, I'd rather not hurt anyone.

jp: 教団に盾突こうなどと
無謀な考えを持つ人の言葉とは
en: Hardly the words of someone reckless enough to think of defying the Church.

jp: 天使にお説教されなくても
en: I don't need an angel to lecture me. I know.

jp: 言わせていただくなら・・・
en: But if I may offer a personal opinion...
I don't dislike that kind of softness.

jp: では、失礼させていただきますわ
en: Then, if you'll excuse me.

jp: お気をつけてお帰り下さいませ
en: Please take care on your way home.
...She vanished.

jp: 気をつけてお帰り下さいませ
en: "Please take care on your way home," she says.

jp: 言われるなんて変な感じだよな
en: Weird, hearing that from an enemy.

jp: 敵の命を助けたりしてる
アタシ達だって十分変よ
en: Doing favors for enemies, sparing enemies' lives... we're plenty weird ourselves.
...No kidding.
Never mind that. Let's get outside, quick!

jp: でも、ヨハネがまだ・・・
en: But Johannes still hasn't...

jp: 追ってくるかもしれないのよ！
待ってる余裕なんてないわ
en: The monk soldiers could come after us any minute! We can't afford to wait.
Hold it! Someone's coming this way!!
...An enemy!?
Cain... is that you?
That voice... it can't be!?

jp: 誰か肩を貸してくれないか？
en: ...Forgive me. Could someone lend me a shoulder?
Johannes!!
Impressive, you're still alive.

jp: 正直、今にも気を失いそうな
en: Somehow... Honestly, I feel like I could pass out any moment...
Johannes!?
No... All this blood...!?
Johannes!!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
